integrity: The infinite formula, conflict-graph decomposition, optimizer classification, and K_{2,2,2} correction are proved analytically. The verifier independently reconstructs the conflict relation and supplies finite stress tests.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite simple complete multipartite graphs. The finite verifier is corroborative only. Literature searches cannot exclude an unindexed correction or an equivalent exact result under different terminology.
title: Correct injective edge chromatic index of complete multipartite graphs
